description: This file declares classes, functions, and constants related to GSSAPI-based HTTP authentication using POSIX libraries, including mechanisms for dynamic library loading, context management, and error reporting within the Chromium project.

classes.name: GSSAPILibrary
classes.description: Abstract interface for GSSAPI library functions, allowing mocking and dynamic loading.

classes.name: GSSAPISharedLibrary
classes.description: Implementation of GSSAPILibrary that loads shared libraries and binds GSSAPI functions.

classes.name: ScopedSecurityContext
classes.description: RAII class managing the lifetime of a gss_ctx_id_t security context.

classes.name: HttpAuthGSSAPI
classes.description: HTTP authentication mechanism using GSSAPI, supporting token generation and context management.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the GSSAPI library or mechanism.

methods.name: init_sec_context
methods.description: Initializes or continues a security context.

methods.name: wrap_size_limit
methods.description: Calculates maximum input size for wrapping.

methods.name: GetGssStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary with GSS status code and message.

methods.name: GetGssStatusValue
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with major and minor GSS status codes and messages.

methods.name: OidToValue
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representing an OID.

methods.name: GetDisplayNameValue
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representing a gss_name_t.

methods.name: GetContextStateAsValue
methods.description: Returns a dictionary describing the state of a GSSAPI context.
